blocks.html: Make your way to the southwestern tip of the island and tie the rope on the hole.

options.text: Come on, this isn't the King Vargas I'm used to.

blocks.html: Lead King Vargas down the path to the north-east and go down the ladder.
blocks.text: Lead King Vargas down the path to the north-east and go down the ladder.

substeps.html: Don't get too far ahead of King Vargas in the tunnels, or the dagannoth will get him and return him to the first chamber meaning you will have to start over. Staying close to King Vargas also ensures he will not be attacked so you won't have to feed him any food. It's recommended to turn off run while escorting King Vargas.

blocks.html: Continue to the far-east side of the next tunnel, past the small obelisk, and climb up the ladder.
blocks.text: Continue to the far-east side of the next tunnel, past the small obelisk, and climb up the ladder.

blocks.html: The next ladder to climb up is to the west, in this short tunnel dagannoth will spawn that prioritise attacking King Vargas, make sure you attack them so they will focus their attacks on you instead.

substeps.html: After defeating the sentinels, you can go to bank to get more food. You don't need to fight the sentinels again. Also you don't need the tablets or the seal of passage for the fights (saves you a few slots for food).

blocks.html: Alternate attacks between the dagannoth, keeping their health within approximately 500 life points to prevent them from healing each other.
blocks.text: Alternate attacks between the dagannoth, keeping their health within approximately 500 life points to prevent them from healing each other.

substeps.html: High level players with good equipment can just kill one then the other, it is easy to deal more damage than the amount that they are healed.
substeps.text: High level players with good equipment can just kill one then the other, it is easy to deal more damage than the amount that they are healed.

substeps.html: There is a common glitch that prevents you from attacking the second sentinel. In this case stand on top of the sentinel you cannot attack. This will prevent it from attacking or healing the first sentinel.
